labels.look: Black, serif sentence mixing roman and italic with a green hand-drawn 'NaN', dagger ornament, 'Infinite Scroll'
labels.ux: Infinite scroll specimen; the specimen is editable
labels.learn: The hero sentence lists the styles (Text, Italic & Display) while demonstrating them

labels.look: Huge white katakana on black edge to edge; 'CONTRAST 50%' readouts top and bottom
labels.ux: Wheel/scroll changes the contrast axis live
labels.learn: Map scrolling onto a variable axis: the visitor drives the design space without seeing a control

labels.look: White heavy grotesque on black, bottom-anchored, roman plus italic
labels.learn: Naming the styles in the wordmark ('regular, italic') makes it informative as well as loud

labels.variantDefinition: A glyph shown as its construction (Bézier points, skeleton, strokes), often animated, exposing how it is drawn
labels.look: Dark gradient, magenta numeral '2' outlined with on-curve and off-curve points; small caption
labels.learn: Start from the outline points: it signals craft and introduces the font's variable 'wght 266'

labels.look: Dotted stitch-grid name on orange, photo of real knitted letters below, scrolling marquee
labels.learn: Show the physical origin (knitting) next to the digital letters

labels.look: Black condensed mono name on white, italic tagline
labels.learn: The minimal baseline: name plus one line that says what it is

labels.variantDefinition: The type is animated (drawn on, morphing, 3D, generative) as the main hero content
labels.look: White, thin line letters 'LEON S' being drawn stroke by stroke
labels.learn: A code-drawn font can show its own drawing process live

labels.look: Neon green, 3D extruded wireframe 'Java' in blue lines
labels.learn: Extruding the letters in 3D shows off bold shapes even before any text

labels.look: Lavender field, thin rounded 'marbla' cropped off the left, short description
labels.ux: static (the wordmark likely animates through axes)
